routes.title: KERNEXT — The Next Core of Computing.
routes.description: KERNEXT is a native Rust shell engine with a real PTY, a local Axum runtime, and one terminal that runs on the CLI, web, and desktop.

routes.title: KERNEXT Features — A Native Rust-Powered Shell
routes.description: A real lexer, parser, and evaluator in Rust: native pipelines, redirections, scripting, background jobs, a genuine PTY, and one engine behind the CLI, web, and desktop surfaces.

routes.title: About KERNEXT — Independent. Native. Engineered.
routes.description: KERNEXT is an open, powerful, independent Rust shell engine. One execution path, three surfaces, honest verification claims.
